messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered -> PD-INC-4821 (sev: P1). Automatic page to oncall rotation. summary: node gpu-rack-45 host unreachable / kubelet NotReady. links: https://pagerduty.example/PD-INC-4821 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Page sent to rotation 'infra-oncall'. Escalation policy: 3m -> 10m. Auto-retries enabled.

Priya: acked. oncall here. seeing kube shows node 'gpu-rack-45' NotReady, and monitoring shows node heartbeat lost ~90s ago. Is there any tenant impact?

incident-bot: K8s events (last 5m):
```
LAST SEEN   TYPE     REASON             OBJECT                                     MESSAGE
2m          Warning  NodeNotReady       node/gpu-rack-45                            Kubelet stopped posting status
3m          Warning  KernelPanic        node/gpu-rack-45                            kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
4m          Warning  EvictionThreshold  pod/embedding-worker-7                      Node memory pressure
```

Recent kernel oops snippet from syslog (collected by node-exporter):
```
[ 3312.123456] ------------[ cut here ]------------
[ 3312.123459] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
[ 3312.123462] CPU: 1 PID: 1234 Comm: kubelet Not tainted 5.10.0-1039
[ 3312.123465] Call Trace:
[ 3312.123468]  dump_stack+0x5c/0x8a
[ 3312.123471]  panic+0x101/0x2d0
[ 3312.123474]  ? schedule+0x0/0x120
[ 3312.123477]  ???
```

Javier: I can see the node's serial console log stopped right after the oops. NVMe errors just before the panic: `nvme0: I/O 0 QID 0 timeout`. This looks like a hardware-triggered kernel panic, not a kubelet-only issue.

Liam: If it's hardware, let's cordon & migrate workloads. Priya, can you cordon gpu-rack-45 and evict critical pods to spare nodes? I'll prepare drain commands and watch for stateful sets.

Priya: on it. running:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-rack-45
kubectl drain gpu-rack-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --pod-selector='app in (embedding-worker,model-server)'
```

Priya: Cordoned. Drain started. Some model-server pods are stuck in Terminating because of long shutdown timeouts. Starting parallel replacements on other racks.

Sam: alerting product/support: several requests to /v1/embeddings have 503s from our edge layer. Error spikes to ~2.7% for last 3 mins (baseline 0.1%). Traffic routing has started failing over where possible but sticky sessions to node42/45 cause some 503s. Customer impact: a few large customers on Dedicated might see embedding latency/timeouts. Notified support-runbook.

Javier: attempting remote management now. IPMI shows host responsive but SEL logs show fatal PCIe error and multiple uncorrectable errors. Running: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.0.45.12 -U admin -P **** sol activate`

Priya: good call. If IPMI console allows, try a soft reboot first; if serial shows kernel oops persists, we should power-cycle. Liam, confirm whether we have spare GPU capacity to reschedule high priority pods.

Liam: spare capacity available in rack-42 and rack-47 for low-priority batch jobs; model-server replicas can be scaled from 3->5 temporarily in region-a to absorb traffic. I'll run a rolling scale: `kubectl -n mlscale scale deployment model-server --replicas=5`

Javier: attaching serial console - here's the output (sanitized):
```
-- bootconsole --
[ 3311.999 ] nvme0: aborting command
[ 3312.120 ] kernel: nvme0: I/O 0 QID 0 timeout
[ 3312.123 ] panic: stack trace
[ 3312.124 ] ---
```
IPMI soft-reset initiated. Waiting ~30s for hardware reset.

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: PD-INC-4821 -> acknowledged by Priya at 1719004335.

Priya: IPMI reports host state = REBOOTING. Monitoring for kubelet re-register. If it doesn't return in 10m we escalate to infra for rack-level replacement.

Sam: product/sales informed. Logged incident in SRE notes with PD ticket link and customer impact summary.

(4m later) incident-bot: IPMI reports POST complete. Serial shows kernel starting userland. Kubelet attempting to register.

Javier: node is back to Ready? kubelet registers but `kubelet` logs show out-of-memory oom-killer events during pod restoration; some pods crashloop. Running quick healthcheck: `kubectl get nodes gpu-rack-45` -> `Ready,SchedulingDisabled` then `Ready` after adapters stable.

Priya: uncordon delayed until pods healthy. I'll keep it cordoned while autoscaled replicas absorb load.

Liam: scaled replicas are up. traffic error rate dropping to 0.3% over last 2 mins. Good signs.

Sam: monitoring shows customer error rate returning to baseline. Notifying support to close interim customer messages after 30m.

Priya: handoff to morning oncall in 18m. I'll mark this incident as mitigated but not fully resolved; action items: schedule hardware ticket for NVMe replacement (ticket HW-9872), keep node cordoned until replaced and stress-tested.

Javier: filing hardware ticket now and attaching serial logs.

incident-bot: PD-INC-4821 status -> mitigated by Priya at 1719005521. No data exfiltration detected. Postmortem assigned to oncall-runbook owner.

Priya: thanks everyone. I'm leaving notes in the incident doc and will hand off to @Liam for next steps on replacement and long-term remediation. :thumbsup:
